name: sse-multiline-data-joins-with-newlines
title: Several `data:` lines in one frame join with a newline between them
why: A JSON payload containing a newline is split across data lines by the spec. Joining with anything else corrupts it.

sse:
id: 1
event: stage
data: {"id":1,"kind":"stage","stage":"turn","state":"started","stream":"stage","ts":"2026-09-02T00:00:00Z","data":"{\"turn_number\": 1, \"turn_id\": \"t1\"}"}

id: 2
event: output
data: {
data:  "id": 2,
data:  "kind": "output",
data:  "stream": "acp",
data:  "turn_id": "t1",
data:  "ts": "2026-09-02T00:00:00Z",
data:  "blocks": [
data:   {
data:    "kind": "text",
data:    "body": "line one\nline two"
data:   }
data:  ]
data: }

id: 3
event: stage
data: {"id":3,"kind":"stage","stage":"turn","state":"done","stream":"stage","ts":"2026-09-02T00:00:00Z","data":"{\"turn_number\": 1, \"turn_id\": \"t1\", \"stop_reason\": \"end_turn\"}"}
